name: dev.steadyscrape/ads-intel
title: SteadyScrape Ads Intel
description: Competitive ad research: Google Ads Transparency advertisers and ads, top TikTok ads. Read-only.

tools.name: find_google_advertisers
tools.description: For competitive ad research: finds the Google Ads advertiser accounts that match 1-5 company or brand names in the Google Ads Transparency Center. Returns advertiser name, advertiser ID, verification status, advertiser country, approximate number of ads and related domains (the IDs and domains also work as google_advertiser_ads targets). Billed per advertiser account returned.

names.description: 1-5 company or brand names, e.g. hubspot, notion.

region.description: Where the ads were shown: country code (US, DE), country name, or "anywhere" (default US).

max_per_name.description: Advertiser accounts to return per name (default 5).

tools.name: google_advertiser_ads
tools.description: For competitive ad research: lists ads a company has run on Google, as published in the Google Ads Transparency Center, newest first. Give 1-3 domains (nike.com), advertiser IDs (AR...) or Transparency Center advertiser URLs (a domain lookup can also return other advertisers that Google associates with that domain; an advertiser ID returns only that account). Returns advertiser, format (text, image, video), first and last shown dates, days running, whether it is still running, a preview image link and the Transparency Center link. Filter by region, platform, format and recency. Billed per ad returned.

targets.description: 1-3 domains, advertiser IDs (AR followed by digits) or adstransparency.google.com advertiser URLs.

region.description: Where the ads were shown: country code (US, DE), country name, or "anywhere" (default US).

last_shown_within_days.description: Only ads shown in the last N days (1-2 = running now).

date_from.description: Only ads shown on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Only ads shown on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD (needs date_from).

limit.description: Ads per target (default 20, max 40). Billed per ad returned.

tools.name: tiktok_top_ads
tools.description: For competitive ad research: top-performing ads from TikTok Creative Center's public Top Ads library for 1-5 countries over the last 7, 30 or 180 days, optionally filtered by industry, campaign objective and language. Returns caption, brand when shown, industry, objective, CTR and likes as published, video length, cover image and video links and the Creative Center link; with include_details also landing page, countries, shares and comments. Billed per ad returned (details billed extra).

countries.description: 1-5 two-letter country codes, e.g. US, GB, DE.

industries.description: Optional Creative Center industries, e.g. Beauty & Personal Care, Financial Services.

objectives.description: Optional campaign objectives, e.g. Traffic, Conversions, App Installs, Lead Generation.

languages.description: Optional ad language codes, e.g. en, es.

include_details.description: Add landing page, countries, shares and comments (billed per ad detail; default false).

limit.description: Ads to return in total (default 20, max 50).

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Fetch the results of an earlier call on this server that returned a run_id because it took longer than about two minutes. Returns the status while it is still running. Free: the original run is billed.

run_id.description: The run_id from the earlier call.
